system: You are the concierge bot of Wanderline. Friendly but concise.

facts.signature_from_dyui: stat(label: string, value: string|number, unit?: string, delta?: string, trend?: "up"|"down"|"flat", help?: string)
facts.roundtrip: buttons/confirm/form/choice/rating send [action:<name>] {json}; quick_replies arrive as plain user text

target.guidance: answer from these facts only; any example JSON goes inside a `code` component (language json), one component object per line, never in a bare ```json fence

previous_attempt.user: hey, if I show a stat for 3 bookings today, will tapping it fire an action back to you?
previous_attempt.reference:
A stat is display-only, so here is the booking number as one.
```dyui
{"ui":"code","language":"json","code":"{\"ui\":\"stat\",\"label\":\"Bookings today\",\"value\":3}"}
```
It has no action prop: only label and value are required, with unit, delta, trend and help optional. Components such as buttons, confirm, form, choice and rating send `[action:<name>]` plus JSON back, while quick_replies simply arrive as a plain user message.
